data.desc: Kenon is a holding company initially established to promote the growth and development of our primary businesses. Over the last decade, Kenon's businesses and holdings have substantially evolved and unlocked substantial shareholder value, with Kenon demonstrating a track record of achieving strong shareholder return. Kenon currently has a 46% interest* in OPC, a leading owner, operator and developer of power generation facilities in the Israeli and U.S. power markets.
